              "description": "Active jobs with a visit today."
            },
            {
              "name": "upcoming",
              "description": "Active jobs with a visit in the future (after today)."
            },
            {
              "name": "action_required",
              "description": "These are jobs that are still active, but they have no more upcoming visits. You can think of action required like being 'on hold'. Action required is a prompt to either schedule more visits or close the job."
            },
            {
              "name": "on_hold",
              "description": " These are jobs that are still active, but they have no more upcoming visits. You can think of action required like being 'action required'. On hold is a prompt to either schedule more visits or close the job. (alias for action_required)"
            },
            {
              "name": "unscheduled",
              "description": "These are jobs that have visits created, but the visits have been set up to be scheduled later."
            },
            {
              "name": "active",
              "description": "Active jobs are the jobs in progress (the job is not closed). This includes other statuses (late, today, upcoming, ...)."
            },
            {
              "name": "expiring_within_30_days",
              "description": "Active jobs that are expiring within 30 days."

Distinct from MarketingItemChannel — this enum exists to prevent non-social channels (email, website) from being supplied to the social connection's channels filter at all, rather than silently ignoring them at runtime.",

        {
          "name": "SocialMarketingItemDisplayStatus",
          "kind": "ENUM",
          "description": "Display-level status for a marketing item on the Social Post tab. These values are a UI-facing projection of the underlying MarketingItemStatus, collapsing `unscheduled` and `generated` into DRAFT or MISSED based on the scheduled date in the account's local timezone.",
          "fields": null,
          "enumValues": [
            {
              "name": "DRAFT",
              "description": "An item that has not been scheduled, or whose scheduled date is today or in the future (maps to status IN (unscheduled, generated) AND (start_at IS NULL OR start_at >= today))."
            },
            {
              "name": "SCHEDULED",
              "description": "An item scheduled to be sent (status = scheduled)."
            },
            {
              "name": "SENT",
              "description": "An item that has been sent (status = sent)."
            },
            {
              "name": "FAILED",
              "description": "An item whose delivery failed (status = failed)."
            },
            {
              "name": "MISSED",
              "description": "An item whose scheduled date has passed without being approved (maps to status IN (unscheduled, generated) AND start_at < today)."
            }
          ]
        },
        {

            {
              "name": "CONTENT",
              "description": "Sort by the scheduled item's title (to_dos.title) — the same string the UI shows in the Content cell."
            },
            {
              "name": "CREATED_BY",
              "description": "Sort by the snapshotted author label (marketing_items.author). NULL author rows collate alongside the explicit \"Marketing Agent\" label, matching the GraphQL-edge translation (NULL ⇒ \"Marketing Agent\")."
            },
            {
              "name": "STATUS",
              "description": "Sort by the displayed (derived) status — DRAFT, FAILED, IN PROGRESS, MISSED, SCHEDULED, SENT — not the raw marketing_items.status column, so the ordering matches the chip the user sees. Derivation mirrors Marketing::MarketingItem.with_derived_status using today in the account's timezone."
            },
            {
              "name": "CHANNEL",
              "description": "Sort by the channel enum string (marketing_items.channel)."
            }
          ]
        },
